root_causes.description: A network partition isolating the payment service prevents checkout's outbound gRPC call to payment from ever completing, so checkout blocks until its deadline and the delay propagates upstream to frontend. Because the fault is at the network boundary, payment emits no server spans and its own request_rate, error_rate and resource metrics stay flat/normal (zero errors, normal CPU, zero restarts), ruling out in-process faults.

evidence.expected_baseline: > 0.1 req/s server spans (payment is a live checkout dependency with inbound calls)
0 (fault occurs before payment produces a span, so failures surface upstream as timeouts, not payment errors)
normal (< 0.05 cores) — no CPU saturation, rules out cpu_stress

root_causes.description: An abort injected at the payment HTTP/gRPC boundary drops checkout's outbound call before it reaches payment, producing the same zero-span / zero-error signature on payment while blocking checkout. Distinguished from the partition hypothesis only by inspection of the injected fault configuration (flagd flag vs. NetworkPolicy).

evidence.expected_baseline: > 0.1 req/s and < 0.01 error_rate for a healthy payment service

root_causes.description: A pod crash of payment would also remove server spans, but this is strongly contradicted: restart counts are zero and no CrashLoopBackOff/OOMKilled events were observed. Included only as a low-probability alternative.

evidence.expected_baseline: crash-loop or kill events for a crashing pod

remediation_steps: Inspect and remove/roll back any NetworkPolicy or network-partition injection isolating the payment pods in namespace otel-demo to restore connectivity between checkout and payment.
Disable/roll back the flagd flag reconciling on payment (the only k8s activity observed in the window) to clear any injected boundary fault.
Restart the payment deployment pods to re-establish checkout→payment gRPC channels and clear stuck/aborted connection state.
Verify recovery: confirm payment server-span request_rate returns to baseline and checkout p99 latency / frontend error_rate normalize.
